denominator_policy: Every entry is infrastructure- or contract-invalid and is excluded from model denominators. Raw outputs remain on the ali-owned PVC.

attempts.reason: Initial model-free Isaac launches stopped before a valid exact-scene fixture because the portable environment inherited an unwritable cache, the selected Vulkan ICD path was absent, and libGLU/libXt dependencies were missing. One retry overlapped another exact-scene preflight and segfaulted during RTX plugin teardown.
attempts.resolution: Selected the live /etc/vulkan/icd.d/nvidia_icd.json mount, isolated writable caches, prevented concurrent Isaac launches, and staged the missing Ubuntu 22.04 native libraries in a user-owned PVC prefix.

attempts.reason: Vulkan recognized the RTX device, but libGLU/libXt were still missing and an overlapping preflight left the MDL renderer startup invalid.
The isolated native-library repair allowed exact-scene creation, but buffered shutdown hid the downstream missing-right-camera adapter exception and no fixture or manifest was produced.
attempts.resolution: Added durable milestone and technical-failure retention before the Isaac shutdown path.

attempts.reason: The neutral reset and both false predicates passed, then the official DreamZero adapter raised KeyError: over_shoulder_right_camera because the default RoboLab registration exposed only left-shoulder and wrist image observations.
attempts.resolution: Use RoboLab's upstream WRIST_LEFT_RIGHT policy-camera preset, which adds the official mirrored right-shoulder sensor without changing objects, reset state, or predicates.

attempts.reason: A first camera repair referenced a configclass field at class scope and failed during task import before scene creation.
The right camera sensor was attached at the task scene layer but not added to RoboLab's image-observation group, so the official adapter still rejected the observation.
attempts.resolution: Replaced the task-local camera edit with the upstream WRIST_LEFT_RIGHT registration preset for both sensors and observation terms.

next_command: Complete the exact two-B200 official DreamZero server gate on isolated port 18017, then run the fixed-observation exact-repeat and LEFT/RIGHT prompt-only sensitivity probe. Do not start a behavioral cell until it passes.
